summary: Iteration-2 (optimization) full-stack testing complete. Backend: 36/36 pytest tests pass (33 regression from iter-1 + 3 new: new SettingsIn fields persist, hero_slides update+GET, broken image URL patterns absent). Frontend: mobile 375px shows 2-col grids on Home services / /services / Gallery / Doctors as required; desktop 1920px shows 4-col home services, 3-col /services, 3-col gallery, 3-col doctors. Zero horizontal scroll on Home/Services/Gallery/Doctors/Appointment/Contact at 375px. SafeImage fallback SVG correctly replaces broken images (verified by injecting bad URL — swapped to data:image/svg+xml with 'Image unavailable'). All 25/28 home images use loading='lazy'. Admin Settings page has new Logo URL field, Footer Description textarea, and Hero Slides editor with Add/Remove per slide — save persists to backend and returns via /api/settings. Hero slider prev/next/dots all present with data-testids.

issues: Category filter chip strip is horizontally scrollable — individual chip buttons extend past viewport (right: 393-869px). Container has overflow-x scroll so body does NOT overflow, but a visible right-fade indicator would improve UX. Not a bug — intentional design pattern.
2/28 elements on Home have no explicit loading attribute (likely floating-button icons via lucide-react rendering into ). Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Add a right-side fade/gradient hint on the /services category chip strip on mobile so users know it scrolls horizontally.
(Optional) Set loading='lazy' on any remaining raw without the attribute (currently ~2 on Home).
(Cleanup optional) Existing carry-over test data from iter-1 (TEST_ prefixed testimonials/contacts and one TEST_Service) has been cleaned up during this run.
critical_code_review_comments: SafeImage.jsx is used correctly across Services/Doctors/Gallery/ServiceDetail/DoctorDetail — good abstraction.

One legit React warning observed on Home: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' — a component is passing fetchpriority (lowercase) to a raw . Non-blocking but should be renamed to fetchPriority for React 18 correctness.
Navbar.jsx uses `settings.logo` with correct onError → hides img; Footer.jsx uses `settings.footer_text` with sensible fallback. Both work as expected.
SettingsIn model (server.py:244-264) correctly extends with logo, footer_text, homepage_hero_title, homepage_hero_subtitle and preserves hero_slides list.
seed_content service list no longer references the four broken photo IDs — verified via GET /api/services (0 offenders).
index.css sets html/body {overflow-x: hidden} and img {max-width: 100%} — verified prevents mobile overflow across all 6 tested pages.

Still applies from iter-1: server.py is a 1000-line monolith — consider splitting into routers. No rate limiting on /api/auth/login. CORS_ORIGINS='*' + allow_credentials=True combination is browser-rejected for credentialed calls; frontend relies on Bearer tokens so it works, but strict setup preferred.
